- **Citation details:** Other papers cite it as Glass GE, *Aesthetic Surgery Journal* 2021, vol. 41, no. 6, pp. 723-738, DOI 10.1093/asj/sjab025 (Aesthetic Surgery Journal 41, no. 6 (2021;18): 723-738, 10.1093/asj/sjab025). - **Correction:** A correction notice was published in April 2022 (DOI 10.1093/asj/sjab396). It is listed under the 2021 article's citation, but the search results don't say what it changed. Check the notice before citing the article.
- **Related work by the same author:** A 2023 systematic review on the oncologic safety of PBM for skin rejuvenation in the same journal. Its conclusion is that current clinical and preclinical evidence suggests that PBM is oncologically safe for skin rejuvenation.
- **Citing literature:** Later reviews cite the 2021 article as a source on clinical PBM applications, including one on ophthalmology and one on LED use in cosmetic dermatology.

For the article's abstract and full text, I'd go to the journal's site or PubMed using the DOI above.
